mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 32 degrees that feels like 22. Look out for the full moon tonight, alongside an ISS pass overhead that unfortunately will be hidden behind clouds.

Looking ahead to Thanksgiving, City of Verona offices and the recycling center will be closed on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27. Thursday refuse and recycling pickup will be delayed until Friday, November 27. Additionally, the city is evaluating space needs for a new Public Works and Utilities facility to support local growth.

For local events, you can drop in for Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow brings trivia fun with Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's, plus a 50th anniversary craft brewing celebration coming up on Friday at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In weekly police news, on Wednesday, November 4, officers responded to a parking lot collision on East Verona Avenue where a 34-year-old driver was arrested for O W I while carrying a passenger under 16 years old.
Over at Culver's, doors open today at 10:00 AM. Today's Flavor of the Day is Butter Pecan, so stop by later for a delicious frozen treat.
